proof_body:
by
  intro P a b ha
  have hroot : (P - Polynomial.C (P.eval (-b / a))).IsRoot (-b / a) := by
    simp [Polynomial.IsRoot]
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := Polynomial.dvd_iff_isRoot.mpr hroot
  refine ⟨Polynomial.C a⁻¹ * S, ?_⟩
  have hb : Polynomial.C b = - (Polynomial.C a * Polynomial.C (-b / a)) := by
    rw [← Polynomial.C_mul, ← Polynomial.C_neg]
    congr 1
    field_simp
  have hone : Polynomial.C a * Polynomial.C a⁻¹ = (1 : Polynomial ℝ) := by
    rw [← Polynomial.C_mul, mul_inv_cancel₀ ha, Polynomial.C_1]
  rw [hb]
  linear_combination hS - (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (-b / a)) * S * hone
target_source: ∀ (P : Polynomial ℝ) (a b : ℝ), a ≠ 0 → ∃ Q : Polynomial ℝ, P = (Polynomial.C a * Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C b) * Q + Polynomial.C (P.eval (-b / a))
